ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with high-contrast separation; approximately 55% high-intensity (white/cream/yellow) and 45% low-intensity (black) pixel regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) anchor extending from the peduncle to the notch; lateral lobes dominated by high-intensity (white) fields transitioning to low-intensity (black) pigmentation at the distal tips and along the trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; narrow angle approximately 35-40 degrees with significant depth relative to the fluke centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations across both lobes; prominent jagged peaks and valleys localized on the distal third of both the left and right trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the lower leading edge; trailing edge exhibits a convex curve that terminates in sharply tapered, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular black ring scar located in the upper quadrant of the right lobe's white field; multiple small dark punctate marks distributed across the medial white regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical and diagonal high-contrast white linear streaks concentrated on the central black region; distinct dark diagonal rake marks (lines) cutting across the white fields of both lateral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical linear scarring (white on black) on the central fluke area; a prominent circular parasitic or barnacle scar on the right lobe white field; irregular serration pattern suggests minor historical edge trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown organic staining (biofilm) localized on the proximal and medial portions of the white pigmentation fields on both lobes.
